events.description: Musique Royale welcomes contemporary klezmer band Queen Kong to perform at the Old Confidence Lodge in Riverport on Tuesday July 28 at 7 pm. Queen Kong has earned national recognition in Canada, winning the Canadian Folk Music Award for Instrumental Group of the Year.
